messages:
jordan_sales: quick sync 10am PT 6/12Novus.ai wants a 3-week POC to validate SSO + SCIM + strict tenant email locking. they
lso asked about role mapping and audit retention for HIPAA. can we scope and pricing?

rachel_se: short: SAML (Okta) supported, IdP & SP-initiated. SCIM v2 with PATCH/delta supported. group->role mapping in Console. domain proofing via TXT + verified tenant claim.

lee_infosec: checklist items: signed assertions mandatory, customer requires encrypted assertions and 2-year key rotation plan. need to confirm whether NameID format should be email or persistent. also want audit trail for provisioning events and admin actions.

vera_ops: pricing note: recommend Hosted for quick validation unless they need BAA/HSM. Hosted POC est $1k-1.5k/week depending on token use; Dedicated trial (3w) needs small reserved commit ~ $3k one-time for predictable latency; Private is custom. will confirm HIPAA/BAA path.

jordan_sales: Novus: can you confirm expected daily DAU and provisioning spikes? that'll drive whether Dedicated is needed.

oliver_engineer: for SCIM throughput: Hosted default 600 reqs/min, Dedicated can allow 1200 burst. PATCH is very efficient for deltas. sample PATCH we use: 
```
PATCH /Users/3c5f9
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "path": "name.givenName", "value": "Alex" }]
}
```

infra-bot: ticket INF-4897 created to reserve a Dedicated test node (1x A10g equiv) for novus-poc, window 3 weeks. assigned: eng-runtime.

lee_infosec: on sessions: default idle timeout 60m; Novus requests 15m. we can set per-tenant session TTL on Dedicated/Private. also will they need IP allowlist for SSO endpoints?

rachel_se: Novus replied: DAU ~8k, onboarding spikes up to 6k/day during migration, HIPAA applies, audit retention min 1y, will require assertion encryption and customer KMS for keys.

vera_ops: Hosted supports audit logs 90d by default; enterprise add-on extends to 1y. Dedicated can integrate with customer KMS (key wrap) and Private supports on-prem HSM. for HIPAA/BAA we usually recommend Dedicated or Private.

jordan_sales: actions: 1) Novus to send SP metadata + sample Okta group export + IP allowlist, 2) rachel to draft POC SOW & test plan (week1 SAML+domain proof, week2 SCIM+RBAC, week3 scale + signoff), 3) vera to prepare pricing sheet (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + BAA note, 4) infra to confirm INF-4897 provisioning schedule.

oliver_engineer: also note RBAC mapping snippet we'll share: Console supports mapping rules like `okta:group==\"eng:admin\" -> role:platform_admin`. can also stage via canary flag for rollout. will paste example in SOW.

lee_infosec: one more: for encrypted assertions we need to exchange public keys. Novus must provide IdP public cert and we'll supply SP cert + metadata. outline in SOW.

rachel_se: I'll compile and send to Novus legal/infosec. aiming to get invoices + test creds ready by Monday. :thumbsup:

jordan_sales: thanks team, i'll follow up after SOW sent.
